lines.hook: Every repo deserves a launch trailer. Nobody has time to make one.
lines.reveal: So we built Shipreel. An agent that directs it for you.
lines.cmd: One command. Point it at any GitHub repo.
lines.crew: Six models. One network. The entire crew runs on Livepeer.
lines.director: A director reads your README, and writes the storyboard. No invented claims.
lines.critic: A camera shoots every keyframe. A vision critic reviews each take, and sends the bad ones back.
lines.motion: The keepers come alive. Then it records the voiceover, and scores the music.
lines.words: AI video still can't spell. So every word on screen is real type, set with HyperFrames.
lines.receipt: And every run is priced before it spends a cent.
lines.intro: This is the trailer it made about itself.
lines.close: Shipreel. Every repo deserves a launch trailer.
